title: Curphey Cottage Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Curphey Cottage is a 3.00 bedroom, 3.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: 54 NATCHEZ STREETCoastal Comfort Steps from the BeachExperience relaxed coastal living at Curphey Cottage, a completely renovated vacation rental in Seaside, Florida, located just 272 feet (about a one-minute walk) from the sugar-white sands of the Gulf and only half a block from Seaside’s West End pool. With convenient front-of-home parking and a welcoming open-air porch, this charming cottage invites you to slow down and settle into beach life from the moment you arrive. Adirondack seating for two creates the perfect spot to enjoy morning coffee while the sound of waves drifts in from the shore.Inviting Living Spaces with Designer StyleInside, the open-concept living area is thoughtfully designed for comfort and connection. The lounge features two oversized sofas, a cozy club chair, and a wall-mounted flat-screen TV with a Bose sound bar—ideal for movie nights, game nights, or winding down after a day at the beach. Throughout the home, luxury furnishings and curated design details by Beau Interiors elevate the space while maintaining an inviting, livable feel. Just off the living room, the expansive screened side porch becomes the heart of the home, offering six rocking chairs for long conversations, shared laughter, and peaceful moments any time of day.Renovated Kitchen and Indoor-Outdoor DiningThe fully renovated kitchen anchors the home with both beauty and functionality. A spacious island with seating for four, custom built-in cabinetry, and seamless flow into the dining area make entertaining effortless. The kitchen is well equipped with a four-burner electric cooktop, full-size refrigerator, dishwasher, microwave, toaster, Keurig, coffee maker, and ample cookware. Nearby, the dining room features a farmhouse table that comfortably seats eight and opens directly to the screened porch for easy indoor-outdoor dining. A built-in bay-window bench creates a cozy reading nook, while an additional conversation area at the rear of the home offers even more space to relax.Private Bedroom Suites for Restful RetreatsOn the main level, the king primary suite provides a peaceful retreat with a private en-suite bathroom featuring a single vanity and a glass-enclosed walk-in shower. Upstairs, two beautifully appointed bedroom suites, one king and one queen, offer comfort and privacy for additional guests. Each bedroom includes blackout curtains, generous storage, and a private Juliet balcony with a rocking chair—perfect for quiet mornings or evening breezes. One en-suite bath features a glass-enclosed walk-in shower and oversized single vanity, while the other offers a tub and shower combination, ideal for relaxing after beach days. Thoughtful touches like a curated selection of classic novels and beach reads add to the home’s welcoming charm.Tower Room and Outdoor AmenitiesAt the top of the home, the glass-enclosed tower room serves as a light-filled hideaway with club seating for two and a twin daybed. This versatile space works beautifully as a reading lounge, quiet escape, or additional sleeping area. Outdoor amenities include a private enclosed outdoor shower for rinsing off after the beach, a lush fenced yard with seating for five, a large private driveway with off-street parking, and a full-size washer and dryer. Every detail at Curphey Cottage has been thoughtfully considered, ensuring your Seaside vacation is as effortless, comfortable, and memorable as possible.* 5-night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer; 3-night minimum Fall; 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES1,873 square feet272 feet or a 1-minute walk to beach access at Natchez Pavilion, one of the largest private residential beaches on 30ALarge-screen smart TV (all TVs are digital streaming only)Private driveway for off-street parkingEnclosed private outdoor showerWasher and dryerSmall private porches with rocking chairs off each bedroomHigh-speed, password-secured WiFiAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities provided2 parking passes issued (a golf cart is considered a vehicle; golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners unless approved for special circumstances or medical needs)No pets allowedSTR23-001958
